title: Acceptance and invited method
summary: Acceptance manifests assent to the offer in an invited or required manner.
notes: An offer may request a return promise, completed performance, or conduct capable of expressing commitment. First identify what the offer asks for; then identify the alleged responsive act and any notice requirement. Wucherpfennig finds further negotiations, International Filter finds a stipulated approval, White finds insufficient communicative preparation, and Ever-Tite finds commencement expressly invited by the form.
